newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 2 pct Lensvyaz telecom July 17. [corrected 16:50]
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 2 pct Lensvyaz telecom July 17. [corrected 16:50]

text.p: Russia will auction a two percent stake in regional telecom Lensvyaz on July 17, a statement from the Leningrad regional property fund said on Monday(corrects date).
The auction was originally due to be held on June 10, but administrative problems delayed the sale, the statement said.
Monday is the last day bids will be accepted for the two-percent stake, comprising 53,038 ordinary shares with a face value of 100,000 roubles. The starting price for each share is 220,000 roubles.
Lensvyaz posted 1996 pre-tax profit of 67.5 billion roubles, up from 41 billion roubles in 1995. Net profit rose to 47 billion roubles from 19.5 billion roubles.
Holding company OAO Svyazinvest owns 38 percent of Lensvyaz, and the Leningrad property fund owns 22 percent.
